Tests tower vote logic and serialize/deserialize behavior.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_tower` API. It creates a tower in local scratch memory, then checks vote insertion, vote expiration, root update behavior, and vote order and confirmation counts. The [`test_vote`](<#test_vote>) function verifies how `fd_tower_vote`, `fd_tower_simulate_vote`, `fd_tower_votes_cnt`, and `fd_tower_votes_peek_index` work together when the tower reaches its limit and when a new vote causes an old vote to expire or a new root to form.

The file also tests data import and file format handling. The [`test_tower_from_vote_acc_data_v1_14_11`](<#test_tower_from_vote_acc_data_v1_14_11>) and [`test_tower_from_vote_acc_data_current`](<#test_tower_from_vote_acc_data_current>) functions load tower state from vote account data and compare the stored votes against expected slot and confirmation values. The [`test_serde`](<#test_serde>) function checks serialization and deserialization of tower file data with `fd_tower_deserialize` and `fd_tower_serialize`. [`main`](<#main>) initializes the runtime with `fd_boot`, runs the selected tests, and then shuts the runtime down with `fd_halt`.
